* Hometown: the decipher.com Bespin squadron page lists "Apple Valley, MI"; the Bespin region and the Duluth listing on the same page point to Minnesota. Left as published. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 11:01, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the left-hand adult in a Facebook photograph posted 14 September 2019. The Facebook photo viewer names Dion Erbes. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (group member since 27 February 2009). Gold 102 Apple Valley, Minnesota. He wears a Star Wars t-shirt in front of the Millennium Falcon. Dest the crop of that named subject; the uncropped original stays in Photographs. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Dion Erbes portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Dion Erbes Facebook portrait.jpg]].
